failedAssertions.reason: Heavy-chain numbered-result and germline-assignment coverage passes for every allowed species, but HMM-loading coverage is implemented as a for-loop rather than pytest parameterization, so the file does not literally parametrize all three required dimensions.

Using productive macaque IGH sequence_id=772 from bum_igl_assignment_macaque.feather, Airr("macaque").run_single() routed to macaque HMMs but returned j_call, sequence_alignment_aa, and germline_alignment_aa as nan; run_mutational_analysis(..., "kabat") then raised KeyError("Id").
The renumbering-level rhesus compatibility tests pass, but the full user-facing Airr entry point does not: Airr("rhesus") raises BadDataSet instead of behaving identically to Airr("macaque").

appliedUpdates.description: Documented the current `Airr("rhesus")` entry-point failure and the reproducible raw-sequence macaque `VAL-CROSS-001` failure path discovered during test-hardening validation.
